nodes.brama.text.t: Three wait by the gate, the ones Gnieworad could spare: a joker with a sword at his belt, a girl with a spear, and a skinny little scribe with a bundle bigger than himself.

nodes.ragnoslawa.text.t: Ragnosława rests her spear on her shoulder and sizes you up. "Know what's eating me? A letter with a red seal, and the master wouldn't look us in the eye. Did you ask anything?"

nodes.ragnoslawa_ok.text.t: "Done!" She snorts with laughter, the first time since morning. "Just don't think I'll let you win."

nodes.skarimir.text.t: "To the capital, at imperial expense! If nothing eats us on the way, at least we'll eat our fill when we get there, eh, hero?" Skarimir grins like he's off to a wedding.

nodes.skarimir_smiech.text.t: "That's the spirit!" He slaps you on the back so hard you barely keep your feet. "The more the merrier, even to the grave."

nodes.wojmir.text.t: Wojmir clutches his bundle till his knuckles go white. "I… I've never been further than the market. And those officials look at me like they're reckoning how much fat they'll render out of me."

nodes.wojmir_ok.text.t: Wojmir nods and tries to smile. "God repay you. I'll remember who didn't laugh at me."
